title: Strategic rollout summary canvas for Private/VPC clusters
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design a compact, actionable 'Rollout Summary Canvas' for Private/VPC clusters that surface the combined operational, cost, and network-risk view for upgrade waves. The canvas is intended for platform operators and tenant owners to quickly understand: what will change, which subnets/nodes are affected, the likely cost delta (egress + instance delta), a per-tenant risk score, and one-click mitigation actions (pause, shrink wave, emergency rollback). This ticket covers a mid-fidelity prototype, interaction spec for canary staging lanes, and a small handoff artifact for Engineering and PMs to implement the frontend surface and backend telemetry hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype in Figma covering: summary header, cost-delta strip, risk heatmap, timeline lanes for canary -> progressive -> full, and emergency controls
Interaction spec that defines: hover states for subnet rows, drill-through to cluster timeline, and keyboard-accessible emergency rollback flow
A11y checklist completed (contrast, keyboard nav, screen-reader labels) and documented in the ticket
Clear data contract defined for Eng: list of affected tenants, per-tenant cost estimate, risk score formula, and rollout stage timestamps
Sign-off from Platform PM (Priya Singh) and Infra Eng lead (Ethan Ross) on the prototype before dev handoff
design_notes: Canvas principle: single-pane actionable summary — avoid deep navigation for on-call workflows
Cost-delta strip uses inline sparklines + absolute delta; ability to switch between 7d and 30d baselines
Risk heatmap computes a composite score: network fragility (recent packet drops), capacity headroom, and tenant SLA tier; color-blind-safe palette required
Timeline lanes: each lane corresponds to a rollout stage; progressive lanes animate subtle state changes; explicit timestamps and estimated completion shown
Emergency controls: compact flyout with 'Pause wave', 'Shrink to canary', and 'Initiate rollback' — include confirmation, reason field, and suggested rollback target
Drill-through for a tenant opens a contextual panel showing: affected nodes, recent errors, egress estimate, and last successful checkpoint
Offline mode: if telemetry gaps exist, canvas degrades to 'partial data' mode with clear badges and recommended verification steps
Cost estimator uses conservative bands (low/median/high) and shows primary contributors (instance delta, egress, cache invalidation)
decisions: Use a combined cost+risk header rather than separate panels to reduce cognitive load — chosen over separate drilldowns
Opted for progressive reveal of per-tenant details (inline flyouts) not full-page nav to preserve context during incidents
Heatmap color scale will use normalized percentiles per-cluster to avoid cross-cluster misinterpretation
Emergency rollback will trigger a soft-stop API first; irreversible full rollback requires an explicit extra step — to limit accidental rollbacks
